{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate for each channel, stratified by customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute overall conversion rate for each channel
overall_conversion = conversion_rates.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference = overall_conversion['email'] - overall_conversion['paid_search']

# Print the difference
print(f"Email conversion rate: {overall_conversion['email']:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {overall_conversion['paid_search']:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
